page_title: MNT 0-2 MON | Montpellier v Monaco 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
90+1' 3:8 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
88' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Edan Diop (Monaco) comes onto the pitch so that Krepin Diatta can be given a rest.
86' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Caio Henrique (Monaco) replacing Kassoum Ouattara.
86' It is time for a substitution. Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) is on for Maghnes Akliouche.
85' Goal disallowed! Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) scores but Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
82' Akor Adams (Montpellier) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
82' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' The resulting set piece from Montpellier is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' The corner is swung in but Montpellier can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' The substitution has been made. Mohamed Camara (Monaco) has replaced Eliesse Ben Seghir.
72' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is the one who receives a yellow card.
70' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Khalil Fayad is replaced by Sacha Delaye (Montpellier).
70' The game has come to an end for Modibo Sagnan. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
68' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
65' Montpellier take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

65' 0 - 2 GOAL! A great pass finds Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 0:2.
64' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
61' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to make a change. Akor Adams (Montpellier) replaces Mousa Al-Tamari.
61' Substitution. Othmane Maamma (Montpellier) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Yann Karamoh walks off.
59' Rough tackle by Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

52' 0 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Folarin Balogun, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco), who beats Dimitry Bertaud with a brilliant shot into the top right corner. 0:1.
52' Thilo Kehrer (Monaco) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Breel Embolo doesn't have to suffer any longer with the painful injury as Folarin Balogun (Monaco) comes onto the pitch to replace him.
44' Breel Embolo (Monaco) picks up an injury.
42' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
39' The shots on goal statistics – 1:4.
37' The ball is cleared after Joris Chotard (Montpellier) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
34' Problems for Michel Der Zakarian as Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Joris Chotard replaces him.
33' Breel Embolo (Monaco) has a goal ruled out for offside!
31' Wonderful movement by Monaco. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
28' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
23' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
20' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Stephanie Frappart and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
18' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
15' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) makes a strong challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
11' A pass by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Mohammed Salisu (Monaco) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Stephanie Frappart blows for a foul.

8' Youssouf Fofana (Monaco) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
7' Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
5' Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
3' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Monaco will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
